title: REQ · Typed manifest and object schemas with runtime validators
summary: Manifest and world object zod schemas export inferred TS types
description: Context: no manifest or object schema exists. Desired behavior: AssetManifest records id, path, type, dimensions, spritesheet frames, animations, origin/anchor and interaction bounds; object schema covers position, scale, layer, bounds, actions, visibility conditions and persistent-state fields. Why: single validated contract for content.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid manifest entry for each asset type, When parsed, Then it succeeds and returns typed data
Given an entry with missing id, negative dimensions or unknown type, When parsed, Then it fails naming the offending field path
Given a world object with position, scale, layer, bounds, actions, visibleWhen and persistentState, When parsed, Then it succeeds; an unknown layer fails
